newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks edge up at close after fickle trade.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks edge up at close after fickle trade.

text.p: Mexican stocks rose Tuesday after a quiet session.
The blue chip IPC index closed up 4.7 points, or 0.14 percent, at 3,374.42. Volume was 90.3 million shares.

"Dealers may also be wary of the high levels the Dow Jones has reached, and suspect that it may adjust downwards, which would hurt us," said Santos Herrera, analyst at the Estrategia Bursatil brokerage.
The Dow Jones industrial average rose 10.44 points to a record 6,266.04 for the fifth straight session.
Dealers also said they had discounted government bond auction results, due later in the day.
On the broad market scoreboard, 112 stocks changed hands, with gainers outnumbering losers by 43 to 39.
Food company Maizoro headed the leaders, up 20 centavos ($0.03) at 3.00 pesos ($0.38), on a favourable outlook for the company's exports, traders said.
The only percentage loser traded at appreciable volume was financial stock BBVPro, down one centavo ($0.01) to 45 ($0.06).
Technical analysts said the bourse was consolidating in order to gather steam to break out of the 3,400 point mark.
